method: Member list paginated through the find-a-member infinite-scroll endpoint, filtered by domain id per cluster (e.g. ?f[0]=domain:3606), deduplicated. Companies with an open careers page were then checked for junior/entry-level postings (WebSearch to find the careers URL, WebFetch or a rendered browser to read the content); a subset of postings received a second, deeper read of the full posting body for requirements, languages, salary and status.
name: Agoria member directory (find-a-member)
